part: Doepfer A-100 bus connectors of A-100 modules (a100b_e.gif) - J-PWR-EURO pin allocation
notes: 638x379 GIF, 'bus connectors of A-100 modules', the image embedded in the banked a100t_e.html (its ), which the saved HTML does not carry. Image only - no text layer. Reads, for the 16-pin version drawn at the 'right lower corner of PC board', bottom pair to top: -12V, GND, GND, GND, +12V, +5V, CV, Gate; the 10-pin version: -12V, GND, GND, GND, +12V. It prints no pin numbers: pin 1 at the -12 V pair is the red-stripe convention the page's text states ('-12V line is marked with a colored wire ... aligned to the bottom'), so pins 1-2 -12 V, 3-8 GND, 9-10 +12 V, 11-12 +5 V, 13-14 CV, 15-16 Gate. Banked for hardware/module/power-entry's J-PWR-EURO pin map.
